Two separate road accidents result in multiple fatalities

Two distinct road accidents have been reported, each resulting in fatalities. In Koldihha, a woman died after being hit by a speeding motorcycle, and the rider has been taken into custody. Residents in the area have demanded speed breakers due to frequent accidents. Separately, in Sambhal, a collision between a speeding truck and a tempo claimed the lives of three individuals.
